nations.name: Bishop Paiute Tribe
nations.lands: Bishop, California, at the eastern Sierra Nevada

facts.text: The Tribe’s timeline recounts a 1912 reservation of more than 67,000 acres in the Owens Valley and its federal revocation in 1932.
The Tribe’s Cultural Center page records a June 13, 1978 resolution by the Owens Valley Board of Trustees to support a permanent cultural center.

source.title: Owens Valley Paiute Shoshone Cultural Center

facts.evidence: a resolution was signed by the Owens Valley

facts.text: The Education Center page describes goals for tutoring, college and career guidance, and support for students and parents.
facts.evidence: offer tutorial services, workshops, scholarship opportunities

facts.text: In its July 7, 2026 broadband meeting update, the Tribe reported trenching progress and planning for home equipment installations.
